name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.13: hourly scheduled config_health ask. The kiosk computes config health only when asked and pushes nothing on a schedule, and the condition it detects — closed lanes the kiosk could not decode, still taking money — can arise after provisioning from a config poll landing oddly or a restart. On a machine with no OTA a kiosk change is a site visit, so asking on a schedule is the only way to catch drift remotely. The sweep runs hourly, five minutes after boot, and only for machines that are online, run our app, and have at least one closed lane, skipping any machine that already has a health check pending so queues cannot stack. Results flow through the existing path, so an undecodable lane still raises a critical alert, emails the operator, and turns the machine-page banner red. Separately noted for the record: the sales payload carries goodsId, qty and amount but no aisle, so the backend cannot attribute a sale to a lane, which is why the empty-lane alert has no data path until the kiosk pushes notable dispenses. Cumulative over v6.12.
